_comment: Edit airports/thresholds here. utc_offset is hours (Russia has no DST). The first airport is the target; the rest are regional controls used to tell 'Irkutsk-specific' apart from 'Siberian weather'.
_budget_comment: RapidAPI units. Each FIDS call = 2 units; one airport-day = 2 calls = 4 units. Free Basic plan = 400/month, Pro = 5000/month. The script refuses to make calls that would exceed this.

intraday._comment: Each intraday run costs 2 units per airport (one 12h window: 6h back, 6h ahead). Needs the Pro plan if run every 3h.

_heartbeat_comment: 0=Mon..6=Sun (Irkutsk local date of the day analysed). A low-priority 'still alive' summary is sent that day so silence never gets mistaken for 'all clear'.
